title: 第7章 两亿特等灵石用来喂猫第8章 天穹境
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
这就是悟道丹！
能让合道境直接提升一小阶的丹药。
不过很多人都知道这枚悟道丹是那些大宗门，大家族必定争夺的，可能起拍价就高得吓人，不过这样也好全当看个热闹！
“悟道丹，起拍价五千万上品灵石，每次加价不得少于五百万上品灵石。”
“既然大家都在观望，那就让老夫来开个头吧！
五千五百万上品灵石”
冥阳宗大长老轻飘飘的开口了
“六千万上品灵石”
“七千万上品灵石”
“七千五百万上品灵石”
各大宗门，家族的人也对这枚悟道丹势在必得。
“大白，想不想要这枚悟道丹？”
“真的可以吗？主人！”
“便宜货而已！”
“反正你现在也承受不了彩鳞果的药力，还不如吃这颗悟道丹提升提升。”
“呜呜X﹏X，主人你对我太好了。”
大白眼泪汪汪的看着青墨
悟道丹的价格已经上升到八亿上品灵石，喊价声慢慢变少了，哪怕是一品宗门一下子拿出八亿上品灵石也要肉疼得紧。
现场的人早已目瞪口呆，八亿上品灵石啊！
他们哪里见过那么多灵石！

“雨柔，我们还剩多少上品灵石”
“主人，我们还剩几万上品灵石了。”
柳雨柔有些脸红，感觉自己好像花得太多了，自己身上加青墨的那两亿上品灵石被花得还剩几万。
“用这个去喊价”
青墨扔了一个储物戒指给柳雨柔，里面静静躺着上万条特等灵石矿脉。
柳雨柔整个人都麻了。
“真是豪啊！”
“九千万特等灵石”
（下品，中品，上品，极品灵石。
1：10）
在柳雨柔加价的同时，青墨在翻系统商城，看看有没有合适柳雨柔的体质，虽然她本身是先天灵体，但是在青墨的眼里还是低了。
“鸿蒙体，混沌体，万法道体……”
在场所有人听到柳雨柔的话全部倒吸一口凉气，哪怕是隐世宗门都没那么豪啊！
只有中洲举行十年一次的拍卖会上才会出现用特等灵石来竞价。
“这位姑娘，老夫怀疑你根本没有那么多特等灵石？”
“呵呵，本公子也怀疑你没有那么多特等灵石。”
“拍卖行你们随意让人抬价的吗？”
在场所有人都带着怀疑的目光看着柳雨柔。
“自己没有倒是见不得别人有，真是笑话。
可以让拍卖行的人过来验证，本小姐到底能不能拿出来这点特等灵石！”

秋月亲自过去验证，她在拍卖行主持了那么多场拍卖会，从来没见有人喊出那么高的价格！
柳雨柔直接让她看到戒指内上万条特等灵石矿脉，整个人震惊在原地。
“我是谁，我在哪，我在干什么？”
好一会才缓过来，在她离开包厢的时候深深看了眼闭着眼睛撸喵的青墨，不知道在想什么。
content_en:
This is the Enlightenment Pill!
An elixir that can directly improve the Hedao realm by a small level.
However, many people know that this Enlightenment Pill is something that the big sects and families must compete for. The starting price may be frighteningly high, but this is just a fun thing to watch!
"The starting price for the Enlightenment Pill is 50 million high-grade spiritual stones. Each increase in price must not be less than 5 million high-grade spiritual stones."
"Since everyone is waiting and watching, let me make the beginning!
Fifty-five million high-grade spiritual stones”
The Great Elder of Mingyang Sect spoke lightly.
"Sixty million high-grade spiritual stones"
"Seventy million high-grade spiritual stones"
"Seventy-five million high-grade spiritual stones"
People from all major sects and families are also determined to get this Enlightenment Pill.
"Dabai, do you want this Enlightenment Pill?"
"Is it really possible? Master!"
“It’s just a bargain!”
"Anyway, you can't bear the medicinal power of the Colored Scale Fruit now, so you might as well take this Enlightenment Pill to improve yourself."
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu
Dabai looked at Qingmo with tears in his eyes
The price of the Enlightenment Pill has risen to 800 million high-grade spiritual stones, and the price shouting has gradually become less and less. Even if a first-grade sect takes out 800 million high-grade spiritual stones at once, it still feels painful.
The people at the scene were already stunned, eight hundred million high-grade spiritual stones!
Where have they seen so many spiritual stones!
"Yurou, how many high-grade spiritual stones do we have left?"
"Master, we have tens of thousands of high-grade spiritual stones left."
Liu Yurou blushed a little, feeling like she had spent too much. The 200 million high-grade spiritual stones with green ink on her body were spent and she still had tens of thousands left.
"Use this to bid"
Qing Mo threw a storage ring to Liu Yurou, inside which lay quietly tens of thousands of special spirit stone veins.
Liu Yurou's whole body was numb.
"How proud!"
"Ninety million special spiritual stones"
(Low grade, medium grade, top grade, top grade spiritual stone.
1:10)
While Liu Yurou was raising the price, Qing Mo was browsing the system mall to see if there was anything suitable for Liu Yurou's physique. Although she was an innate spirit, she was still low in Qing Mo's eyes.
"Hongmeng body, chaotic body, Wanfa Dao body..."
Everyone present took a breath when they heard Liu Yurou's words. Even the hidden sect was not that proud!
Only at the ten-year auction held in Central Continent would bids for special spiritual stones appear.
"Girl, I suspect that you don't have that many special spiritual stones?"
"Haha, I also suspect that you don't have that many special spiritual stones."
"At the auction house, do you allow people to raise prices at will?"
Everyone present looked at Liu Yurou with suspicion.
"If I don't have it, I can't see others having it. It's really a joke.
We can ask people from the auction house to come and verify whether I can produce this special spiritual stone! "
Qiuyue went over in person to verify that she had hosted so many auctions at the auction house and had never seen anyone shout out such a high price!
Liu Yurou directly showed her the tens of thousands of special spirit stone veins in the ring, and she was shocked.
"Who am I, where am I, what am I doing?"
It took her a while to recover. When she left the box, she took a deep look at Qing Mo, who was meowing with her eyes closed. She didn't know what she was thinking.
